g.text: BC-06 Fulfillment & Delivery — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
POD and TemperatureEvidence are independent Aggregate Roots; corrections are addenda.
Temperature excursion may HOLD. ContinuationDelivery links parent and child Delivery roots.
Driver Outcome is not Buyer Receipt; handoff token resolution is not acceptance.
Partial delivery opens ContinuationDelivery; it does not rewrite history.
